_comment_enforceBssid: Collecting BSSIDs and enforcing them are separate steps on purpose. While this is false the BSSIDs below are recorded but NOT checked, and verification falls back to source IP. Turn it on only once you have confirmed every access point radio your staff actually connect to is listed - otherwise anyone on a missing radio silently stops being counted. Discover them with: npm run bssids
_comment_networks: All BSSIDs below belong to ONE physical access point (ba:9f:cc:db:52:5x). Note that the SSID named 'Trans K 2.4G' broadcasts on BOTH bands - the 2.4GHz radio on channel 11 and a 5GHz radio on channel 40 - so the name does not tell you the band. Verified by netsh wlan show networks mode=bssid on 2026-08-27.

networks._comment: The router's un-renamed factory SSID, on the same physical AP. Listed so that anyone who happens to join it is still counted. It had zero connected stations when surveyed - if nobody needs it, disable it on the router and delete this entry.
networks.name: Router default SSID (disable if unused)

_comment_infrastructure: Infrastructure IPs are never treated as employee devices.
_comment_retention: Days to keep raw presence_events and unknown-device records. Derived attendance_days rows are kept indefinitely (they are the payroll record).
_comment_unknownDevices: A device must be seen at least this many times before it is reported as an unrecognised device on the office network. Defence in depth behind the firmware BSSID filter: a single stray sighting is noise, not a device that is actually here.
_comment_schedule: Forgotten Women default schedule (spec section 6). These are the ORG-WIDE defaults only. Per-employee overrides live in the working_patterns table, because the spec requires different employees, departments and offices to be able to run different schedules.
_comment_grace: CONFIRMED by Forgotten Women: 10 minute grace period. With an 11:00 start that means arrivals up to 11:10 (such as 11:01 or 11:10) are on time (0 late minutes, 0 deficit). Arrivals from 11:11 onwards are late with deficit measured beyond grace (at 11:11, deficit is 1 min).
_comment_lateness: CONFIRMED by Forgotten Women on 2026-08-27: 3 late occurrences are allowed per CALENDAR MONTH, and the 4th triggers HR warning review. The count resets on the 1st of each month.
_comment_warnings: Warning policy CONFIRMED by Forgotten Women on 2026-08-27, resolving the items spec section 35 left open. Escalation is driven by WARNING HISTORY, not by which warnings are currently active: a warning goes inactive after warningExpiryMonths but still counts toward the next level, so escalation progresses instead of resetting every month.
_comment_escalationExhausted: What follows a final written warning is NOT defined by the spec and has not been confirmed. The engine therefore stops at the last level in the sequence and marks the trigger as requiring an HR decision outside the system, rather than inventing a level such as dismissal.
_comment_escalateOnEvery: Confirmed: the late count does not reset when a warning is issued, and every further late occurrence in the same month escalates. With a limit of 3, the 4th raises an informal notice, the 5th a first written and the 6th a final written. HR still confirms each one before it becomes formal.
_comment_absence: Confirmed: NO automatic consequence for an unauthorised absence. The three switches spec 10.2 requires to be independent are all null, meaning undecided-by-design: the system records and flags the absence, and a person chooses the outcome case by case. This is what stops one day producing both a leave deduction and a pay deduction by default.
_comment_leave: Leave policy CONFIRMED by Forgotten Women on 2026-08-27. The holiday year runs from each employee EMPLOYMENT ANNIVERSARY, not the calendar year, so accrual cannot be computed for anyone without a start date on their employment record. The engine reports that as blocked rather than assuming a date.
_comment_accrual: MONTHLY_ON_COMPLETION means the month accrues once it has been WORKED, which is what makes the spec section 14 table come out right: 12 accruals of 20/12 reach exactly 20.00 at month 12. Accruing at the start of each month would give 13 accruals in the first year and overshoot.
_comment_payroll: Payroll policy CONFIRMED by Forgotten Women on 2026-08-27. The daily rate follows spec section 17: monthly x 12 gives the annual salary, then / 52 gives weekly and / 5 gives daily. For 2000 a month that is 24000 annual, 461.54 weekly and 92.31 daily, matching the worked example exactly.
_comment_break: CONFIRMED: the 30 minute break is PAID and part of the working day. That is why 11:00-19:00 counts as 480 minutes for a full day rather than 450 - the break is inside the paid day, not deducted from it.
_comment_alerts: Advanced HR alert lead times, CONFIRMED 2026-08-27 from spec section 20.2. Alerts fire this many days BEFORE the date, and are visible to HR and Super Admin only. Spec section 30 requires these to be configurable.
